description: This file defines the TagsFragment class, a UI component for managing tags within an Android application. It handles displaying, sorting, selecting, and performing actions on tags, including navigation and dialog interactions.

classes.name: TagsFragment
classes.description: A fragment class managing the display and interaction with tags, including sorting, selection, and navigation within the app.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment view, sets up RecyclerView, and configures UI interactions.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu options for tag actions and sorting.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for creating tags and changing sort order.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up references when the view is destroyed.

methods.name: enlistTags
methods.description: Fetches and sorts tags based on user preferences, then displays them.

methods.name: setupRecyclerView
methods.description: Configures the RecyclerView with adapter, layout manager, and interaction handlers.

methods.name: selectSortMethodItem
methods.description: Updates the menu to reflect the current sorting method.
